fr.name: Redmi Pad 2 Pro 5G
fr.description:
Redmi Pad 2 Pro 5G

Redefined Tablet Performance with 5G Connectivity

Redmi Pad 2 Pro 5G combines a large immersive display, powerful processing, long-lasting battery life, and ultra-fast 5G connectivity in a refined design — created for everyday productivity, entertainment, and mobility. 

Immersive 12.1″ 2.5K Display

Experience vivid detail and fluid visuals on the 12.1-inch 2.5K crystal-clear display with a 120 Hz refresh rate and up to 360 Hz touch sampling. Certified by TÜV Rheinland for low blue light and flicker-free viewing, the screen supports Dolby Vision® and reproduces over 1.07 billion colors for rich and comfortable viewing. 

Powerful Snapdragon 7s Gen 4

Powered by the Qualcomm Snapdragon 7s Gen 4 mobile platform (4 nm) with up to Adreno 810 GPU, the tablet delivers responsive performance for multitasking, media, productivity, and casual gaming. 

Multiple Storage Options

Choose between 6 GB + 128 GB or 8 GB + 256 GB memory and storage configurations with LPDDR4X + UFS 2.2, plus expandable storage support up to 2 TB for movies, games, and files. 

5G Connectivity + eSIM

Integrated 5G connectivity with eSIM support takes mobile internet to the next level, allowing fast browsing and streaming without relying on Wi-Fi. Local network compatibility and available bands may vary by region. 

Long-Lasting Battery + Fast Charging

A 12,000 mAh (typ) battery provides extended usage, while 33 W fast charging via USB Type-C ensures you stay powered throughout the day. 

Dual Cameras

Capture photos and video with the 13 MP rear camera (f/2.2) and stay connected with the 8 MP front camera (f/2.28), both supporting up to 1080p video recording. 

Connectivity & Other Features

5G + eSIM network support

Wi-Fi 6 (availability may vary by region)

Bluetooth 5.4 with SBC, AAC, LDAC support

Sensors: Accelerometer, Gyroscope, Ambient Light, Color Temperature, Electronic Compass, Hall sensor

USB 2.0 data transfer 

Premium Build & Software

With sleek dimensions and a 600 g lightweight metal body, Redmi Pad 2 Pro 5G delivers a premium feel. It runs Xiaomi HyperOS 2 for smooth, intuitive interaction and app responsiveness.

USB Type-C Cable

Power adapter 

Quick Start Guide

Warranty Card

Final Statement

A versatile and powerful tablet with a large, vibrant display, robust performance, long battery life, and 5G mobility — crafted for productivity, entertainment, and life on the go.
